title: Jiangsu Pan-Asia Microvent Tech Corporation | China Aerogel Manufacturer
content:
Jiangsu Pan-Asia Microvent Tech Corporation is a listed Chinese high-tech enterprise founded in 1995 and headquartered in Changzhou, Jiangsu. While broadly known for microporous polymer breathable materials and membrane technologies, the company also publicly markets aerogel new materials and aerogel thermal-insulation products for automotive and industrial applications.

Company Overview

Microvent positions itself as a technology-driven materials manufacturer with strong membrane know-how and a growing aerogel product line. Its public site explicitly includes aerogel products and aerogel new materials within a broader advanced-materials platform that serves automotive, electronics, energy, and industrial sectors.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: China-focused supply with recognition from leading domestic and international industrial customers.
  • Focus Areas: Aerogel thermal-insulation products, microporous membrane materials, automotive thermal-management solutions, and advanced material innovation.

Main Products and Capacity

  • Aerogel thermal-insulation pads and related aerogel products
  • Microporous membrane materials and components
  • PEM-related products and other advanced functional materials
  • Public Capacity: Annual aerogel production capacity is not clearly disclosed on the reviewed public pages.

Production Sites and Certifications

  • Main Production Site: No. 8 Qianzao Road, Lijia Town, Wujin District, Changzhou, Jiangsu, China.
  • International Certifications: IATF 16949, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001.
  • Official Website: https://microvent.com.cn
